Synopsis:
                    US Secretary of State Rubio outlined a strategic shift in US anti-drug-trafficking operations in Latin American waters, moving from unilateral military strikes toward joint operations with allied nations (Colombia, Ecuador) within their legal frameworks. The US military has killed at least 230 people in 69 boat strikes since September 2025. The shift signals a more diplomatically coordinated approach while retaining the right to unilateral lethal force where necessary.
